desc: use of fundamentally insecure workflow trigger

symbolic.annotation: pull_request_target is almost always used insecurely

concrete.feature:
on:
  # Post-merge fork verification needs base-repo secrets. Only trusted github.sha
  # is executed; PR head/diff/artifacts are data. See the maintenance trust boundary.
  pull_request_target: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
    types:
      - labeled
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number to verify (must be merged)'
        required: true
        type: string
      mode:
        description: 'Verification mode'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - evaluate
          - checkbox
          - compare
        default: 'evaluate'
      model:
        description: >-
          Model override for evaluation. Leave empty to use slot 1.
          For stricter evaluation, use compare mode with different providers.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      model2:
        description: >-
          Second model for compare mode (cross-provider verification).
          Leave empty to use slot 2.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      evidence_profile:
        description: 'Bounded input limits; expanded retries documented input truncation only'
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [standard, expanded]
        default: 'standard'
      provider:
        description: 'LLM provider override (auto uses slot order)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - auto
          - github-models
          - openai
          - anthropic
        default: 'auto'
comments: # Post-merge fork verification needs base-repo secrets. Only trusted github.sha
# is executed; PR head/diff/artifacts are data. See the maintenance trust boundary.
